key.name: new-filter
key.summary: Episodes shown in New, by played state
key.description: Whether New shows all recent episodes, only played ones or only unplayed ones.

key.name: new-sort
key.description: Whether New lists the newest or the oldest episodes first.

key.name: new-downloaded
key.summary: Episodes shown in New, by download state
key.description: Whether New shows all recent episodes, only downloaded ones or only those not downloaded.

key.name: volume
key.description: Beacon's own audio volume, from 0 to 1.

key.name: refresh-on-startup
key.description: Whether Beacon checks every podcast for new episodes when it opens, as GNOME Podcasts does.

key.name: playback-rate
key.description: How fast episodes play, as chosen in the speed menu.

key.name: play-source
key.summary: List the last episode was played from
key.description: What plays after the queue: “new”, “show:ID”, “favorites” or “downloaded”, or empty for none.

key.name: last-episode
key.description: The episode the queue’s Next from list carries on after, kept across restarts; 0 for none.

key.name: delete-old-downloads
key.description: Whether downloaded episodes are deleted once older than delete-after-days. Queued episodes are never deleted.

key.name: delete-after-days
key.summary: Days before a download is deleted
key.description: How many days old a download gets before it is deleted, when delete-old-downloads is on.

key.name: delete-only-played
key.description: Whether only played episodes are deleted, counting days from when each was played; otherwise days count from when the download finished.
